claims.statement: For each PLOS 2021 Table 2 BC and IC genotype, the full source CellML metabolite/growth/dilution model leaves K={1.8<=F<=2.2, 0.585<=A<=1.5, P>=2, A+P<=14} forward invariant under actual-flux feedback U=L-(F-2)+e when |e|<=0.15 mM/min. Since 0.585 mM exceeds each exact CellML ATP-profit threshold, H is nondecreasing there for H>0.
claims.status: conditional theorem; exact rational facet calculation with ln(2)<0.7 over published rounded Table 2 genotype decimals
assumptions: PLOS Table 2 values are treated as exact at their printed decimal precision
CellML fourth-power expression-cost formula and its fixed vatper=5, vatpm=0 growth normalization
Full H-gated source growth law and its metabolite dilution terms
Total actual upper-flux error, including sensing, fitting, delay and actuation, is at most 0.15 mM/min
An independently addressable glucose input realizes the required upper flux below saturation
The CellML algebraic vacuolar-phosphate law with Kvac=250 mM is accepted
claims.evidence: The exact Fraction verifier checks all six inward face margins for both genotypes, the ATP-profit thresholds, and finite glucose inversion. Weakest margins are 0.017232 mM/min (IC ATP upper) and 0.032769 mM/min (IC ATP lower).
claims.novelty_boundary: The result extends the source-reference cell certificate to the paper's simulated BC/IC genotypes. It is not external validation or a biological claim.
claims.costs: One independently addressable feed per controlled cell/state class; F-only staleness limits are 14.02 s (BC) and 15.49 s (IC) only if all other error sources are zero and ATP/Pi are current. Reporter, calibration and throughput costs are unpriced.
claims.falsifier: Measured parameter uncertainty violates an inward face or ATP-profit threshold; or held-out actual flux tracking exceeds 0.15 mM/min.
claims.next_gate: Acquire strain-specific kinetic confidence sets and joint per-cell F/A/P support, then test a finite-bandwidth implementation.

claims.statement: For the PLOS Table 2 source genotypes, no common glucose input can preserve the lower-F face for a BC cell at (F,A,P,H)=(1.8,0.585,7,1) and the upper-F face for an IC cell at (2.2,0.6,2,1), even with ideal zero-error glucose actuation and full source growth dilution.
assumptions: The two source-model genotypes receive the same extracellular glucose concentration at each time
Both state vectors are required to remain in K
The printed Table 2 genotype decimals and CellML rate laws are used
CellML expression costs are recomputed; both witness ATP profits are positive at H=Hmax
claims.evidence: Let z=G/(0.1+G). BC lower-F inwardness requires z>=0.4699966 (G>=0.088678 mM), using the weaker condition that drops positive growth dilution. IC upper-F inwardness allows z<=0.2377541 (G<=0.031191 mM), using ln(2)<0.7 to upper-bound the full source growth term. The gap is 0.2322426 in z.
claims.novelty_boundary: The states are admissible witnesses, not reported simultaneous trajectories. The source paper models genotype coexistence under common glucose, but the exact witness co-occurrence is not established. This refutes a uniform-tube guarantee for the pair, not all shared-feed recovery strategies.
claims.costs: Two distinct glucose feed concentrations are necessary for this exact simultaneous face pair; one additional independent feed channel is the minimum snapshot actuator increase. Dollars and wet-lab mapping of the simulated genotypes are unknown.
claims.falsifier: The model equations or parameter values are wrong, or an experimental claim that the pair occurs is falsified by joint single-cell state data. The mathematical conditional itself is falsified by an arithmetic/source-model error.
claims.next_gate: Measure joint states and kinetic uncertainty in a named strain panel to test whether the disjoint intervals occur in a real population.

claims.statement: At a fixed measured state/genotype, each active state-face condition in the CellML glucose-driven dynamics is a scalar lower or upper bound on z=G/(0.1+G), because upper uptake is affine in z. Intersecting those intervals over cells and uncertainty support is an exact instantaneous common-feed feasibility test; an empty intersection proves no common glucose command works at that instant.
claims.status: exact source-model interface reduction; general application to measured uncertainty support not yet implemented
assumptions: State and genotype uncertainty support is acquired or explicitly bounded
Active safety faces are specified and the source growth/health branch is known or robustly bounded
All independent Pi/health conditions are checked separately
Finite sampling intervals require additional reachable-set bounds
claims.evidence: The PLOS uptake law factorizes as Vmaxup*q(A)*z. F, ATP, and A+P face derivatives are affine in z; Pi and current health derivatives have no direct z term. The BC/IC witness yields disjoint scalar intervals and a minimum of two feed values by interval stabbing.
claims.novelty_boundary: This is a one-dimensional control-feasibility reduction for the specified uptake interface, not a new general barrier-function theory. Population data, uncertainty sets, and finite-horizon guarantees remain unacquired.
claims.costs: O(number of measured cells times active facets) interval aggregation after acquiring state/parameter bounds; data, sensors, and per-lane fluidics dominate and are unpriced.
claims.falsifier: An implementation of the stated equations finds a common z satisfying all certified conflicting active-face constraints.
claims.next_gate: Build a robust interval estimator from live FBP/ATP and a validated Pi assay, then compare one versus two independently perfused state groups.

claims.statement: For the exact BC/IC witness pair, G_BC=0.1 mM and G_IC=0.03 mM make all active local safety-face derivatives point inward under the full source growth/dilution equations: BC is on F and ATP lower faces; IC is on F upper and Pi lower faces.
assumptions: Same source-model state and parameter assumptions as C7-APP-002
The two witness cohorts receive distinct extracellular glucose setpoints
claims.evidence: Exact Fraction lower/upper bounds are BC Fdot>=0.215206 and Adot>=2.790771 mM/min; IC Fdot<=-0.055250 and Pidot>=15.660389 mM/min. Both have Hdot=0 at Hmax.
claims.novelty_boundary: This closes the local two-face obstruction only; it does not prove a forward-invariant two-lane population tube, basin recovery, or long-term survival.
claims.costs: Two independently perfused glucose channels for the two exact witness cells/classes; within-class state heterogeneity may require additional channels.
claims.falsifier: Any active-face derivative has the wrong sign under exact source arithmetic.
claims.next_gate: Test the state-dependent interval controller over sampled trajectories and finite channel response, not only at the two boundary points.

claims.statement: Whether the BC/IC witness pair occurs in a living yeast population, whether the interval rule improves survival/growth over the best fixed-feed or Tps1/T6P control, and whether the current sensor/actuator stack meets the error budget are unknown.
claims.status: UNKNOWN; no biological, novelty, or priority claim
claims.evidence: The BC/IC values are model-selected genotypes; cited dMSCC studies demonstrate dynamic glucose exposure and ATP/FBP-proxy imaging but not a closed-loop per-cell Pi/F/A glucose controller or the required joint error bounds.
claims.novelty_boundary: Known startup regulation by trehalose/T6P and ATP hydrolysis is established prior art; no advantage is claimed.
claims.costs: Acquire strain-specific flux kinetics, ATP/FBP reporters, Pi assays, genotype/state support, separate feed channels, sensor/actuator calibration, and held-out matched controls. Dollars and throughput remain unknown.
claims.falsifier: The witness states do not occur in the acquired support or all measured state intervals share a common feed value; the proposed two-channel intervention fails the held-out endpoint.
claims.next_gate: Run a blinded dMSCC test against best-fixed, same-information shared MPC, and a known trehalose/T6P or glucose-withdrawal comparator.
